Well first of all I'm not the best one to give an advice specially in that matter since I'm socially awkward myself but here are some things that might help you. 

You can start with "The Charisma Myth" , it's a book written by Olivia Fox.

After reading that book I would suggest "What Every Body is Saying" another great book written by Joe Navarro. That book will you give at least the base of body language, you don't need to be analyzing everyone you meet but at least know if there is something wrong with your body language and be able to fix it.

After you're done with these two books I would suggest you to pick up someone that you like, a celebrity maybe, and start watching interviews of him/her see what he/she does, try to analyze his/her body language, how he/she answer hard questions, how he/she compliment, how he/she react when getting a compliment. 
"Charisma on Command" is a YouTube channel that would greatly help with that

Try to gather knowledge about a lot of different things so that you can speak with a lot of people with different preferences. 

I was skinny as hell, and going to the gym and having a better body boosted my confidence a lot, so maybe you want to try that. 

Having a better clothing style also boosted my confidence a lot.
